groups.sharedExampleZh: 表格要填写动物的性别。 做真实的自己。 你叫什么名字？

groups.title: Family and Friends: care · help
groups.titleZh: 家人与朋友：照顾、帮助
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use care, help in the “Family and Friends” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The baby needs care. I need help with this box.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 婴儿需要照顾。 我需要帮忙搬这个盒子。

groups.title: Family and Friends: support · respect
groups.titleZh: 家人与朋友：支撑、尊重
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use support, respect in the “Family and Friends” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The shelf needs a strong support. We show respect for other people.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 架子需要坚固的支撑。 我们尊重他人。

groups.title: Family and Friends: behaviour · feeling · smile
groups.titleZh: 家人与朋友：行为举止、感受、微笑
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use behaviour, feeling, smile in the “Family and Friends” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Kind behaviour helps everyone. I have a happy feeling today. She gives me a smile.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 友善的举止对大家都有帮助。 我今天感觉很开心。 她对我微笑。

groups.title: My Body: arm · bone · brain
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：手臂、骨头、大脑
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use arm, bone, brain in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My arm is strong. The dog has a bone. Your brain helps you think.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的手臂很有力。 小狗有一根骨头。 你的大脑帮助你思考。

groups.title: My Body: chest · chin · ear
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：胸部、下巴、耳朵
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use chest, chin, ear in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Put your hand on your chest. My chin is below my mouth. This is my left ear.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 把你的手放在胸前。 我的下巴在嘴巴下面。 这是我的左耳。

groups.title: My Body: eye · face
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：眼睛、脸
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use eye, face in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My eye is open. There is a smile on her face.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的眼睛睁着。 她的脸上带着微笑。

groups.title: My Body: finger · foot
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：手指、脚
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use finger, foot in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Point with your finger. My foot is in the shoe.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 用你的手指指一指。 我的脚在鞋里。

groups.title: My Body: hair · hand
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：头发、手
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use hair, hand in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Her hair is long. Give me your hand.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 她的头发很长。 把你的手给我。

groups.title: My Body: head · heart · knee
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：头、心脏、膝盖
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use head, heart, knee in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The hat is on my head. Your heart moves blood. My knee is bent.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 帽子在我的头上。 你的心脏推动血液流动。 我的膝盖弯着。

groups.title: My Body: leg · lip · mouth
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：腿、嘴唇、嘴巴
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use leg, lip, mouth in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My left leg is strong. My lower lip is dry. My mouth is open.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的左腿很有力。 我的下嘴唇干了。 我的嘴巴张着。

groups.title: My Body: muscle · neck
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：肌肉、脖子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use muscle, neck in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This muscle helps my arm move. The scarf is round my neck.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这块肌肉帮助我的手臂活动。 围巾围在我的脖子上。

groups.title: My Body: nerve · nose
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：神经、鼻子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use nerve, nose in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A nerve carries signals in the body. This is my nose.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 神经在身体里传递信号。 这是我的鼻子。

groups.title: My Body: skin · stomach · throat
groups.titleZh: 我的身体：皮肤、胃、喉咙
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use skin, stomach, throat in the “My Body” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My skin feels warm. Food goes into your stomach. My throat is sore.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的皮肤摸起来暖暖的。 食物进入你的胃。 我的喉咙疼。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: apple · basket · berry
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：苹果、篮子、浆果
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use apple, basket, berry in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is an apple. The basket has apples in it. This berry is small.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是一个苹果。 篮子里有苹果。 这颗浆果很小。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: cake · cheese · cup
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：蛋糕、奶酪、杯子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use cake, cheese, cup in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This cake is for you. The cheese is on the plate. This is a cup.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个蛋糕是给你的。 奶酪在盘子里。 这是一个杯子。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: egg · fork
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：鸡蛋、叉子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use egg, fork in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is an egg. The fork is by the plate.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是一个鸡蛋。 叉子在盘子旁边。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: knife · nut
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：刀、坚果
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use knife, nut in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The knife is sharp. The nut has a hard shell.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这把刀很锋利。 坚果有坚硬的外壳。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: orange · plate
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：橙子、盘子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use orange, plate in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This orange is sweet. The plate is on the table.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个橙子很甜。 盘子在桌上。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: pot · potato · spoon
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：锅、土豆、勺子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use pot, potato, spoon in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The soup is in the pot. This potato is for our soup. This spoon is for my soup.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 汤在锅里。 这个土豆用来做汤。 这把勺子用来喝汤。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: tray · cow · farm
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：托盘、奶牛、农场
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use tray, cow, farm in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The cups are on the tray. The cow is in the field. The farm has sheep and cows.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 杯子在托盘上。 奶牛在田野里。 农场里有羊和奶牛。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: fowl · goat
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：家禽、山羊
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use fowl, goat in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A hen is a fowl. The goat is on the hill.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 母鸡是一种家禽。 山羊在小山上。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: horse · pig
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：马、猪
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use horse, pig in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The horse is in the field. The pig is on the farm.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 马在田野里。 猪在农场里。

groups.title: Food and the Farm: plough · seed · sheep
groups.titleZh: 食物与农场：犁、种子、绵羊
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use plough, seed, sheep in the “Food and the Farm” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The plough turns the earth. Put the seed in the earth. The sheep is in the field.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 犁翻开泥土。 把种子放进泥土里。 绵羊在田野里。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: bread · milk · water
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：面包、牛奶、水
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use bread, milk, water in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I have some bread. I have some milk. I have some water.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我有一些面包。 我有一些牛奶。 我有一些水。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: butter · cook · drink
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：黄油、厨师、饮料
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use butter, cook, drink in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Put some butter on the bread. The cook makes soup. Water is a good drink.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 在面包上放一些黄油。 厨师在做汤。 水是很好的饮品。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: food · fruit
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：食物、水果
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use food, fruit in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We need food every day. I have some fruit for you.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们每天都需要食物。 我有一些水果给你。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: grain · meal
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：谷物、一餐
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use grain, meal in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The farmer grows grain. We have a meal together.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 农民种植谷物。 我们一起吃一顿饭。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: meat · rice
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：肉、米饭
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use meat, rice in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: There is some meat in the soup. We have rice for dinner.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 汤里有一些肉。 我们晚饭吃米饭。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: salt · soup · sugar
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：盐、汤、糖
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use salt, soup, sugar in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Put a little salt in the soup. The soup is warm. Sugar tastes sweet.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 在汤里放一点盐。 汤是温的。 糖尝起来是甜的。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: wine · jelly · oil
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：葡萄酒、果冻、油
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use wine, jelly, oil in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Wine is made from grapes. The jelly is sweet. Put a little oil in the pan.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 葡萄酒由葡萄酿成。 果冻很甜。 在平底锅里放一点油。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: ice · heat
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：冰、热量
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use ice, heat in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The ice is cold. The sun gives us heat.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 冰是冷的。 太阳给我们热量。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: fire · flame
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：火、火苗
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use fire, flame in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The fire gives us warmth. The candle has a small flame.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 火给我们温暖。 蜡烛上有一小簇火苗。

groups.title: Food and Cooking: liquid · vessel · glass
groups.titleZh: 食物与烹饪：液体、容器、玻璃
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use liquid, vessel, glass in the “Food and Cooking” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Water is a liquid. This vessel holds water. The window is made of glass.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水是一种液体。 这个容器装水。 窗户是玻璃做的。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: bag · band · boot
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：袋子、带子、靴子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use bag, band, boot in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is my bag. The hat has a red band. My boot is wet.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是我的袋子。 帽子上有一条红带子。 我的靴子湿了。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: brush · button · coat
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：刷子、纽扣、外套
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use brush, button, coat in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This brush is for my hair. My shirt has a blue button. My coat is warm.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这把刷子用来梳头发。 我的衬衫上有一颗蓝色纽扣。 我的外套很暖和。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: collar · comb
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：衣领、梳子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use collar, comb in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The shirt has a white collar. This is my comb.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 衬衫有一个白色衣领。 这是我的梳子。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: dress · glove
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：连衣裙、手套
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use dress, glove in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is my dress. This glove is for my left hand.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是我的连衣裙。 这只手套戴在我的左手上。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: hat · jewel
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：帽子、宝石
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use hat, jewel in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is my hat. The jewel is bright.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是我的帽子。 这颗宝石很明亮。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: pocket · ring · shirt
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：口袋、戒指、衬衫
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use pocket, ring, shirt in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The key is in my pocket. The ring is on her finger. My shirt is white.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 钥匙在我的口袋里。 戒指在她的手指上。 我的衬衫是白色的。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: shoe · skirt · sock
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：鞋子、短裙、短袜
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use shoe, skirt, sock in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My shoe is under the bed. Her skirt is blue. This sock is clean.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的鞋子在床下面。 她的短裙是蓝色的。 这只短袜很干净。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: stocking · trousers
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：长袜、裤子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use stocking, trousers in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The stocking is on her leg. My trousers are blue.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 长袜穿在她的腿上。 我的裤子是蓝色的。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: umbrella · watch
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：雨伞、手表
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use umbrella, watch in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My umbrella is yellow. My watch shows the time.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的雨伞是黄色的。 我的手表显示时间。

groups.title: Clothes and My Things: pin · needle · thread
groups.titleZh: 衣物与随身物品：大头针、针、线（缝纫用）
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use pin, needle, thread in the “Clothes and My Things” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The pin holds the paper in place. The needle has a small hole. The thread goes through the needle.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 大头针把纸固定住。 针上有一个小孔。 线穿过针眼。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: baby · blade · boy
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：婴儿、刀刃、男孩
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use baby, blade, boy in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The baby is in bed. The blade is sharp. The boy has a book.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 婴儿在床上。 刀刃很锋利。 那个男孩有一本书。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: bucket · chain · cord
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：水桶、链条、细绳
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use bucket, chain, cord in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The bucket is full of sand. The chain is made of metal. The cord is round the box.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水桶里装满了沙子。 链条是金属制成的。 细绳绕着盒子。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: drop · girl
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：一滴、女孩
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use drop, girl in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A drop of water is on the leaf. The girl has a red bag.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 一滴水在叶子上。 那个女孩有一个红色袋子。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: hammer · hook
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：锤子、挂钩
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use hammer, hook in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The hammer is in the box. My coat is on the hook.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 锤子在盒子里。 我的外套在挂钩上。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: knot · nail
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：结、钉子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use knot, nail in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: There is a knot in the cord. The nail is in the wood.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 细绳上有一个结。 钉子钉在木头里。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: net · rod · screw
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：网、杆、螺丝
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use net, rod, screw in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The net is full of fish. This rod is long and thin. The screw holds the parts together.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 网里满是鱼。 这根杆又长又细。 螺丝把零件固定在一起。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: spade · sponge · spring
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：铲子、海绵、弹簧
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use spade, sponge, spring in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The spade is in the garden. The sponge is full of water. This spring is made of metal.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 铲子在花园里。 海绵吸满了水。 这根弹簧是金属制成的。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: stick · thumb
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：木棍、拇指
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use stick, thumb in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The dog has a stick. This is my thumb.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 小狗叼着一根木棍。 这是我的拇指。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: toe · tongue
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：脚趾、舌头
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use toe, tongue in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My big toe is in the sand. Your tongue helps you taste food.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的大脚趾埋在沙子里。 舌头帮助你尝出食物的味道。

groups.title: People, Tools, and Making: tooth · whip · wire
groups.titleZh: 人物、工具与制作：牙齿、鞭子、金属丝
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use tooth, whip, wire in the “People, Tools, and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This tooth is white. The old whip is in the museum. The wire is thin.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这颗牙齿是白色的。 那根旧鞭子在博物馆里。 这根金属丝很细。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: ant · bee · bird
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：蚂蚁、蜜蜂、鸟
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use ant, bee, bird in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: An ant is on the leaf. A bee is on the flower. A bird is in the tree.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 一只蚂蚁在叶子上。 一只蜜蜂在花上。 一只鸟在树上。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: branch · cat · cloud
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：树枝、猫、云
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use branch, cat, cloud in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A bird is on the branch. This is a cat. The cloud is white.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 一只鸟在树枝上。 这是一只猫。 那朵云是白色的。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: dog · feather
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：狗、羽毛
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use dog, feather in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is a dog. This feather is light.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是一只狗。 这根羽毛很轻。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: fish · fly
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：鱼、苍蝇
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use fish, fly in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The fish is in the water. A fly is on the window.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 鱼在水里。 一只苍蝇在窗户上。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: garden · island
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：花园、岛
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use garden, island in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Our garden has red flowers. The island is in the sea.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们的花园里有红花。 这座岛在海里。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: leaf · monkey · moon
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：叶子、猴子、月亮
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use leaf, monkey, moon in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This leaf is green. The monkey is in the tree. The moon is bright.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这片叶子是绿色的。 猴子在树上。 月亮很明亮。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: rat · root · snake
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：大老鼠、根、蛇
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use rat, root, snake in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The rat has a long tail. The root is under the ground. The snake is long.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 大老鼠有一条长尾巴。 根在地面下面。 这条蛇很长。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: star · stem
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：星星、茎
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use star, stem in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A star is in the sky. The flower has a long stem.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 天上有一颗星星。 这朵花有一根长长的茎。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: sun · tail
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：太阳、尾巴
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use sun, tail in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The sun is bright. The cat has a long tail.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 太阳很明亮。 猫有一条长尾巴。

groups.title: Animals and Nature: tree · wing · worm
groups.titleZh: 动物与自然：树、翅膀、蠕虫
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use tree, wing, worm in the “Animals and Nature” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This tree is tall. The bird has a blue wing. The worm is in the earth.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这棵树很高。 这只鸟有一只蓝色的翅膀。 蠕虫在泥土里。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: angle · ball · board
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：角、球、木板
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use angle, ball, board in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This angle is small. This is a ball. The board is long and flat.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个角很小。 这是一个球。 这块木板又长又平。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: book · camera · card
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：书、照相机、卡片
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use book, camera, card in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is a book. This camera is small. This card is for my mother.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是一本书。 这台照相机很小。 这张卡片是给我妈妈的。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: circle · clock
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：圆、时钟
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use circle, clock in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Make a circle on the paper. The clock is on the wall.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 在纸上画一个圆。 时钟在墙上。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: flag · horn
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：旗子、角（动物的）
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use flag, horn in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The flag is red. The goat has a horn on each side.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 旗子是红色的。 山羊的头两边各有一只角。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: library · line
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：图书馆、线
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use library, line in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The library has many books. Make a straight line.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 图书馆里有很多书。 画一条直线。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: map · match · parcel
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：地图、火柴、包裹
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use map, match, parcel in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This map shows our town. A match can make a flame. The parcel is for you.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这张地图上有我们的城镇。 火柴可以点出火苗。 这个包裹是给你的。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: pen · pencil · picture
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：钢笔、铅笔、图片
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use pen, pencil, picture in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is my pen. My pencil is on the table. This picture shows a cat.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是我的钢笔。 我的铅笔在桌上。 这张图片上有一只猫。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: receipt · school
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：收据、学校
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use receipt, school in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Keep the receipt in your bag. I go to school.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 把收据留在你的袋子里。 我去学校。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: scissors · square
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：剪刀、正方形
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use scissors, square in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: These scissors are for paper. This square has four equal sides.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这把剪刀用来剪纸。 这个正方形有四条一样长的边。

groups.title: School, Shapes, and Signs: stamp · ticket · whistle
groups.titleZh: 学校、形状与标志：邮票、票、哨子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use stamp, ticket, whistle in the “School, Shapes, and Signs” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Put a stamp on the letter. This is my train ticket. The whistle makes a loud sound.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 在信上贴一张邮票。 这是我的火车票。 哨子发出响亮的声音。

groups.title: Learning at School: answer · chalk · education
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：答案、粉笔、教育
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use answer, chalk, education in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I know the answer. This chalk is white. Education helps us learn about the world.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我知道答案。 这支粉笔是白色的。 教育帮助我们了解世界。

groups.title: Learning at School: example · knowledge · language
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：例子、知识、语言
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use example, knowledge, language in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: An apple is an example of a fruit. Books give us knowledge. English is a language.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 苹果是一种水果的例子。 书本给我们知识。 英语是一种语言。

groups.title: Learning at School: learning · letter
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：学习、信
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use learning, letter in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Learning takes time. I get a letter from my friend.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 学习需要时间。 我收到朋友的一封信。

groups.title: Learning at School: list · note
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：清单、便条
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use list, note in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This list has five words. I leave a note on the table.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这张清单上有五个词。 我在桌上留了一张便条。

groups.title: Learning at School: number · page
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：数字、页
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use number, page in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Five is a number. This page has a picture.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 五是一个数字。 这一页有一幅画。

groups.title: Learning at School: paper · question · reading
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：纸、问题、阅读
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use paper, question, reading in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Give me some paper, please. I have a question. Reading is fun.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 请给我一些纸。 我有一个问题。 阅读很有趣。

groups.title: Learning at School: science · teaching · test
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：科学、教学、测试
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use science, teaching, test in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Science helps us understand the world. Good teaching helps children learn. This test checks our hearing.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 科学帮助我们理解世界。 良好的教学帮助孩子学习。 这项测试检查我们的听力。

groups.title: Learning at School: word · writing
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：单词、写作
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use word, writing in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This word has four letters. Writing helps us share ideas.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个单词有四个字母。 写作帮助我们分享想法。

groups.title: Learning at School: ink · print
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：墨水、印刷字体
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use ink, print in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The pen has blue ink. The print in this book is large.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 钢笔里有蓝色墨水。 这本书里的字印得很大。

groups.title: Learning at School: fact · memory · thought
groups.titleZh: 学校学习：事实、记忆、想法
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use fact, memory, thought in the “Learning at School” scene.
groups.sharedExample: It is a fact that ice is cold. I have a happy memory of the trip. A happy thought makes me smile.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 冰是冷的，这是一个事实。 我对那次旅行有美好的回忆。 一个快乐的想法让我微笑。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: attempt · burn · cause
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：尝试、烫伤、原因
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use attempt, burn, cause in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is my first attempt at the puzzle. The doctor puts a bandage on the burn. Rain is the cause of the wet road.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是我第一次尝试这个拼图。 医生给烫伤处包上绷带。 下雨是道路湿润的原因。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: cover · cry · impulse
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：封面、叫喊声、冲动
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use cover, cry, impulse in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The book has a blue cover. I hear a cry for help. I feel an impulse to laugh.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这本书有蓝色的封面。 我听到求救的喊声。 我突然很想笑。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: join · laugh
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：接合处、笑声
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use join, laugh in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: There is a join between the boards. Her laugh makes me happy.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 木板之间有一处接缝。 她的笑声让我开心。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: lead · need
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：铅、需要
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use lead, need in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Lead is a heavy metal. There is a need for clean water.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 铅是一种很重的金属。 这里需要干净的水。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: rub · shake
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：擦拭、摇动
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use rub, shake in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Give the wet dog a rub with a towel. Give the bottle a gentle shake.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 用毛巾擦擦湿漉漉的小狗。 轻轻摇一下瓶子。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: smash · smoke · stitch
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：撞碎声、烟、一针（缝纫）
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use smash, smoke, stitch in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We hear the smash of a falling plate. Smoke goes up from the fire. Make one small stitch in the cloth.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们听到盘子掉下摔碎的声音。 烟从火中升起。 在布上缝一小针。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: surprise · trick · trouble
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：惊喜、戏法、麻烦
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use surprise, trick, trouble in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The card is a surprise for you. The magician shows us a trick. I have trouble opening this box.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这张卡片是给你的惊喜。 魔术师给我们变了个戏法。 我打不开这个盒子。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: turn · twist
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：转弯、扭转
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use turn, twist in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Take a turn to the left. Give the lid a small twist.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 向左转。 把盖子轻轻转一下。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: use · wash
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：用途、清洗
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use use, wash in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: What is the use of this tool? Give your hands a good wash.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个工具有什么用途？ 好好洗洗手。

groups.title: Everyday Actions and Events: waste · wave · wax
groups.titleZh: 日常动作与事件：废物、波浪、蜡
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use waste, wave, wax in the “Everyday Actions and Events” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Put the waste in the bin. A wave comes onto the sand. This candle is made of wax.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 把废物放进垃圾桶。 一个波浪涌上沙滩。 这根蜡烛是蜡做的。

groups.title: Place and Direction: in · on · under
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：在……里面、在……上面、在……下面
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use in, on, under in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The ball is in the box. The book is on the table. The cat is under the table.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 球在盒子里。 书在桌子上。 猫在桌子下面。

groups.title: Place and Direction: at · across · down
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：在（某处）、横穿、向下
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use at, across, down in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I am at home. We go across the bridge. The ball goes down the hill.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我在家。 我们穿过这座桥。 球沿着小山向下滚。

groups.title: Place and Direction: east · far
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：东方、远
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use east, far in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The sun comes up in the east. The school is far from here.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 太阳从东方升起。 学校离这里很远。

groups.title: Place and Direction: forward · here
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：向前、这里
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use forward, here in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Take one step forward. Put the box here.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 向前走一步。 把盒子放在这里。

groups.title: Place and Direction: near · north
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：近、北方
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use near, north in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The school is near our house. North is at the top of this map.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 学校在我们家附近。 这张地图的上方是北方。

groups.title: Place and Direction: off · out · over
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：离开（表面）、在外面、在……上方
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use off, out, over in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Take your shoes off the bed. The cat is out in the garden. The bridge is over the river.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 把你的鞋从床上拿走。 猫在外面的花园里。 桥在河的上方。

groups.title: Place and Direction: south · there · together
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：南方、那里、一起
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use south, there, together in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: South is at the bottom of this map. Put your bag there. We make a cake together.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这张地图的下方是南方。 把你的袋子放在那里。 我们一起做蛋糕。

groups.title: Place and Direction: up · west
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：向上、西方
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use up, west in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The balloon goes up. The sun goes down in the west.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 气球向上升。 太阳从西方落下。

groups.title: Place and Direction: where · from
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：在哪里、从
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use where, from in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Where is my book? This letter is from my friend.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的书在哪里？ 这封信来自我的朋友。

groups.title: Place and Direction: through · to · between
groups.titleZh: 位置与方向：穿过、到、在两者之间
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use through, to, between in the “Place and Direction” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We go through the open door. I go to the library. The ball is between two boxes.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们穿过开着的门。 我去图书馆。 球在两个盒子之间。

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: may · after · before
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：可以（请求许可）、在……之后、在……之前
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use may, after, before in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: May I have some water? We play after school. Wash your hands before dinner.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我可以喝点水吗？ 我们放学后玩耍。 晚饭前洗手。

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: till · how · when
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：直到、怎样、什么时候
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use till, how, when in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We stay here till six. How do you make a paper boat? When do we go to school?
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们在这里待到六点。 你怎样做一只纸船？ 我们什么时候去学校？

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: why · again
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：为什么、再一次
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use why, again in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Why is the floor wet? Say it again, please.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 地板为什么湿了？ 请再说一遍。

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: ever · now
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：曾经、现在
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use ever, now in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Have you ever seen a whale? We can go now.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 你曾经见过鲸鱼吗？ 我们现在可以走了。

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: still · then
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：仍然、然后
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use still, then in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The baby is still asleep. Wash your hands, then have some food.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 婴儿仍在睡觉。 先洗手，然后吃点东西。

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: well · almost · enough
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：好（做得）、几乎、足够
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use well, almost, enough in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: You read this word well. The bottle is almost full. We have enough food.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个词你读得很好。 瓶子几乎满了。 我们有足够的食物。

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: little · much · not
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：少量、许多（不可数）、不
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use little, much, not in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: There is a little milk in the cup. There is not much water left. The box is not heavy.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 杯子里有少量牛奶。 剩下的水不多了。 盒子不重。

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: quite · so
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：相当、如此
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use quite, so in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This box is quite heavy. The sun is so bright.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个盒子相当重。 阳光如此明亮。

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: very · tomorrow
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：非常、明天
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use very, tomorrow in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The water is very cold. We will go to the park tomorrow.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水非常冷。 我们明天去公园。

groups.title: Time, Questions, and Amounts: yesterday · please · yes
groups.titleZh: 时间、提问与数量：昨天、请、是的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use yesterday, please, yes in the “Time, Questions, and Amounts” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I was at home yesterday. Please give me the cup. Yes, this is my book.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我昨天在家。 请把杯子给我。 是的，这是我的书。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: and · because · but
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：和、因为、但是
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use and, because, but in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I have a book and a pen. I have a coat because it is cold. The box is small but heavy.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我有一本书和一支钢笔。 我穿着外套，因为天气很冷。 盒子很小，但是很重。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: or · if · though
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：或者、如果、虽然
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use or, if, though in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Do you want milk or water? If it rains, we stay inside. Though it is cold, the sun is bright.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 你想要牛奶还是水？ 如果下雨，我们就待在里面。 虽然很冷，阳光却很明亮。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: while · as
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：当……的时候、作为
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use while, as in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I read while my sister draws. We use this box as a seat.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我读书的时候，姐姐在画画。 我们把这个盒子当作座位。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: for · of
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：给（某人）、……的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use for, of in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This apple is for you. This is a picture of my cat.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个苹果是给你的。 这是一张我的猫的图片。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: with · about
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：和……一起、关于
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use with, about in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I go with my sister. This book is about birds.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我和姐姐一起去。 这本书是关于鸟的。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: against · among · by
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：靠着、在……之中、在……旁边
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use against, among, by in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The ladder is against the wall. The red flower is among white flowers. The cat is by the door.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 梯子靠着墙。 红花在一片白花之中。 猫在门旁边。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: than · such · other
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：比、这样的、另外的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use than, such, other in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My bag is smaller than your bag. It is such a warm day. The other shoe is under the bed.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的袋子比你的袋子小。 今天是如此暖和的一天。 另一只鞋在床下面。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: some · all
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：一些、全部
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use some, all in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I have some bread. All the cups are clean.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我有一些面包。 所有杯子都很干净。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: any · every
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：任何一个、每一个
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use any, every in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Take any card. Every child has a book.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 随便拿一张卡片。 每个孩子都有一本书。

groups.title: Joining Ideas: no · only · even
groups.titleZh: 连接想法：没有、仅仅、甚至
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use no, only, even in the “Joining Ideas” scene.
groups.sharedExample: There is no milk in the cup. I have only one pencil. Even the small baby can smile.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 杯子里没有牛奶。 我只有一支铅笔。 连小婴儿都会微笑。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: driving · fall · flight
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：驾驶、跌落、飞行
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use driving, fall, flight in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Careful driving keeps people safe. The fall breaks the cup. The bird is in flight.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 谨慎驾驶保障人们的安全。 杯子掉下来摔碎了。 鸟正在飞行。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: guide · harbour · journey
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：向导、港口、旅程
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use guide, harbour, journey in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The guide shows us the museum. The boats are in the harbour. Our journey takes one hour.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 向导带我们参观博物馆。 船停在港口里。 我们的旅程需要一个小时。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: jump · kick
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：跳跃、踢的一下
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use jump, kick in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The frog makes a big jump. One kick sends the ball forward.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 青蛙跳了一大步。 一脚把球踢向前方。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: lift · motion
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：抬起、运动（移动）
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use lift, motion in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Give the box a gentle lift. The wheel is in motion.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 轻轻把盒子抬起来。 轮子在转动。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: move · pull
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：移动的一步、拉力
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use move, pull in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Make one move to the left. Give the drawer a gentle pull.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 向左移动一步。 轻轻拉一下抽屉。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: push · road · roll
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：推力、道路、卷
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use push, road, roll in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Give the door a gentle push. This road goes to the school. There is a roll of paper on the table.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 轻轻推一下门。 这条路通向学校。 桌上有一卷纸。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: run · slip · slope
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：跑步、滑倒、斜坡
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use run, slip, slope in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We go for a run in the park. A slip on the ice makes him fall. The ball rolls down the slope.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们去公园跑步。 他在冰上滑了一下，摔倒了。 球沿着斜坡滚下去。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: start · step
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：开始、脚步
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use start, step in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is the start of our journey. Take one step forward.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是我们旅程的开始。 向前走一步。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: stop · stretch
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：停留、伸展
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use stop, stretch in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We make a short stop at the park. A gentle stretch feels good.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们在公园短暂停留。 轻轻伸展一下很舒服。

groups.title: Movement and Travel: swim · transport · walk
groups.titleZh: 运动与旅行：游泳、运输、散步
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use swim, transport, walk in the “Movement and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We go for a swim. The train is a form of transport. We go for a walk.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们去游泳。 火车是一种运输方式。 我们去散步。

groups.title: Town and Travel: arch · army · boat
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：拱门、军队、小船
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use arch, army, boat in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The arch is over the path. The army has a camp. The boat is on the river.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 拱门横跨小路。 军队有一个营地。 小船在河上。

groups.title: Town and Travel: brake · brick · bridge
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：刹车、砖、桥
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use brake, brick, bridge in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This bicycle has a brake. This brick is red. The bridge is over the river.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这辆自行车有刹车。 这块砖是红色的。 桥在河的上方。

groups.title: Town and Travel: carriage · cart
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：马车、手推车
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use carriage, cart in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The horse pulls a carriage. The cart has two wheels.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 马拉着一辆马车。 手推车有两个轮子。

groups.title: Town and Travel: church · engine
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：教堂、发动机
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use church, engine in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The church has a bell. The engine makes the car go.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 教堂里有一口钟。 发动机使汽车行驶。

groups.title: Town and Travel: gun · hospital
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：枪、医院
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use gun, hospital in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The museum has an old gun. The hospital is near our house.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 博物馆里有一支旧枪。 医院在我们家附近。

groups.title: Town and Travel: office · pipe · plane
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：办公室、管子、飞机
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use office, pipe, plane in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My father is in the office. Water goes through the pipe. The plane is in the sky.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我爸爸在办公室里。 水从管子中流过。 飞机在天上。

groups.title: Town and Travel: prison · rail · sail
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：监狱、栏杆、船帆
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use prison, rail, sail in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The prison has high walls. Keep your hand on the rail. The wind fills the sail.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 监狱有高高的围墙。 把手扶在栏杆上。 风把船帆吹得鼓起来。

groups.title: Town and Travel: ship · station
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：大船、车站
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use ship, station in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The ship is on the sea. The train is at the station.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 大船在海上。 火车在车站里。

groups.title: Town and Travel: store · street
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：商店、街道
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use store, street in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The store has bread and milk. Our house is on this street.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 商店里有面包和牛奶。 我们的房子在这条街上。

groups.title: Town and Travel: town · train · wheel
groups.titleZh: 城镇与出行：城镇、火车、轮子
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use town, train, wheel in the “Town and Travel” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Our town has a library. The train is at the station. This wheel is round.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们的城镇有一座图书馆。 火车在车站里。 这个轮子是圆的。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: amusement · art · canvas
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：娱乐、艺术、帆布
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use amusement, art, canvas in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We read this story for amusement. We make art with paper and paint. The tent is made of canvas.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们读这个故事来消遣。 我们用纸和彩笔创作艺术作品。 帐篷是帆布做的。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: colour · design · fiction
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：颜色、设计、虚构故事
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use colour, design, fiction in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: What colour is your bag? This is my design for a house. This story is fiction.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 你的袋子是什么颜色的？ 这是我为一座房子画的设计。 这个故事是虚构的。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: music · paint
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：音乐、颜料
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use music, paint in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We listen to music. The paint is blue.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们听音乐。 颜料是蓝色的。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: paste · play
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：糨糊、玩耍
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use paste, play in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Use paste to stick the paper down. Children learn through play.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 用糨糊把纸粘住。 孩子们通过玩耍来学习。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: pleasure · rhythm
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：愉快、节奏
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use pleasure, rhythm in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The music gives us pleasure. The song has a slow rhythm.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 音乐带给我们愉快。 这首歌的节奏很慢。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: song · stage · verse
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：歌曲、舞台、诗句
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use song, stage, verse in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is a happy song. The children are on the stage. She reads a short verse.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是一首快乐的歌曲。 孩子们在舞台上。 她读了一段短诗。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: ornament · polish · fold
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：装饰品、擦亮剂、褶皱
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use ornament, polish, fold in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The ornament is on the shelf. We use polish on the shoes. There is a fold in the cloth.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 装饰品在架子上。 我们用鞋油擦鞋。 布上有一道褶皱。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: copy · mark
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：副本、痕迹
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use copy, mark in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I have a copy of the picture. There is a mark on the wall.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我有这张图片的副本。 墙上有一个印子。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: record · story
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：记录、故事
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use record, story in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We keep a record of the weather. Tell me a story, please.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们记录天气。 请给我讲个故事。

groups.title: Art, Music, and Stories: prose · form · humour
groups.titleZh: 艺术、音乐与故事：散文、形状、幽默
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use prose, form, humour in the “Art, Music, and Stories” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This book is written in prose. The cloud has the form of a rabbit. The story is full of humour.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这本书用散文体写成。 这朵云的形状像一只兔子。 这个故事充满幽默。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: air · earth · field
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：空气、泥土、田野
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use air, earth, field in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We need clean air. Put the seed in the earth. The sheep are in the field.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们需要干净的空气。 把种子放进泥土里。 绵羊在田野里。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: flower · grass · land
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：花、草、陆地
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use flower, grass, land in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This flower is yellow. The grass is green. The boat is near the land.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这朵花是黄色的。 草是绿色的。 小船靠近陆地。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: mountain · plant
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：山、植物
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use mountain, plant in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The mountain is high. The plant needs water.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这座山很高。 这株植物需要水。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: rain · river
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：雨、河流
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use rain, river in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The rain makes the grass wet. The river goes through our town.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 雨把草淋湿了。 这条河穿过我们的城镇。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: sand · sea
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：沙子、海
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use sand, sea in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The sand is warm. The sea is blue.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 沙子是暖的。 大海是蓝色的。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: sky · snow · stone
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：天空、雪、石头
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use sky, snow, stone in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The sky is blue. The snow is white. This stone is smooth.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 天空是蓝色的。 雪是白色的。 这块石头很光滑。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: summer · thunder · weather
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：夏天、雷声、天气
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use summer, thunder, weather in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Summer is warm. We hear thunder after the lightning. The weather is warm today.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 夏天很暖和。 闪电之后，我们听到了雷声。 今天天气暖和。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: wind · winter
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：风、冬天
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use wind, winter in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The wind moves the leaves. Winter is cold.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 风吹动树叶。 冬天很冷。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: mist · dust
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：薄雾、灰尘
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use mist, dust in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Mist covers the river. There is dust on the shelf.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 薄雾笼罩着河面。 架子上有灰尘。

groups.title: Earth and Weather: shade · light · ray
groups.titleZh: 大地与天气：阴凉处、光、光线
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use shade, light, ray in the “Earth and Weather” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We sit in the shade of a tree. The lamp gives us light. A ray of light comes through the window.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们坐在树荫下。 灯给我们光亮。 一束光线穿过窗户。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: back · bite · blood
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：背部、咬的一口、血液
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use back, bite, blood in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My bag is on my back. I take a bite of the apple. Blood moves through our bodies.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的书包背在背上。 我咬了一口苹果。 血液在我们的身体里流动。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: body · breath · cough
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：身体、呼吸的一口气、咳嗽
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use body, breath, cough in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My body needs rest. Take a slow breath. I have a cough today.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的身体需要休息。 慢慢吸一口气。 我今天咳嗽。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: disease · digestion
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：疾病、消化
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use disease, digestion in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Clean water helps prevent disease. Digestion helps the body use food.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 干净的水有助于预防疾病。 消化帮助身体利用食物。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: hearing · pain
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：听力、疼痛
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use hearing, pain in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Good hearing helps us enjoy music. I have a pain in my knee.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 良好的听力帮助我们欣赏音乐。 我的膝盖疼。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: sense · smell
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：感官、气味
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use sense, smell in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Smell is a sense. The flower has a sweet smell.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 嗅觉是一种感官。 花有甜甜的香味。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: sneeze · taste · touch
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：喷嚏、味道、轻触
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use sneeze, taste, touch in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The dust makes me give a sneeze. The apple has a sweet taste. A gentle touch wakes the cat.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 灰尘让我打了个喷嚏。 苹果有甜甜的味道。 轻轻一碰就把猫弄醒了。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: wound · rest · sleep
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：伤口、休息、睡眠
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use wound, rest, sleep in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The small wound is clean. I need a rest after the walk. We need sleep every night.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个小伤口很干净。 走路后我需要休息。 我们每晚都需要睡眠。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: condition · fear
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：状况、害怕
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use condition, fear in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The old book is in good condition. The loud noise gives me a feeling of fear.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这本旧书保存得很好。 响声让我感到害怕。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: shock · voice
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：震惊、嗓音
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use shock, voice in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The loud noise gives me a shock. Her voice is soft.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 响声让我大吃一惊。 她的嗓音很轻柔。

groups.title: Health and the Senses: look · sound · noise
groups.titleZh: 健康与感官：看一眼、声音、噪声
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use look, sound, noise in the “Health and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Have a look at this picture. I hear the sound of a bell. The engine makes a loud noise.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 看一看这幅画。 我听到铃的声音。 发动机发出很大的噪声。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: red · blue · green
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：红色的、蓝色的、绿色的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use red, blue, green in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The apple is red. The sky is blue. The leaf is green.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 苹果是红色的。 天空是蓝色的。 叶子是绿色的。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: black · brown · grey
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：黑色的、棕色的、灰色的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use black, brown, grey in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The cat is black. The bear is brown. The cloud is grey.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这只猫是黑色的。 熊是棕色的。 云是灰色的。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: white · yellow
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：白色的、黄色的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use white, yellow in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The snow is white. The sun looks yellow.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 雪是白色的。 太阳看起来是黄色的。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: beautiful · bright
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：美丽的、明亮的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use beautiful, bright in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This flower is beautiful. The sun is bright.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这朵花很美丽。 太阳很明亮。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: clear · dark
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：清澈的、暗的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use clear, dark in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The water is clear. The room is dark.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水很清澈。 房间里很暗。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: clean · dirty · acid
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：干净的、脏的、酸的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use clean, dirty, acid in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My hands are clean. My shoes are dirty. The fruit has an acid taste.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的双手很干净。 我的鞋子脏了。 这种水果有酸味。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: bitter · sweet · cold
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：苦的、甜的、冷的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use bitter, sweet, cold in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The medicine tastes bitter. The cake is sweet. The water is cold.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 药吃起来很苦。 蛋糕很甜。 水是冷的。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: warm · wet
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：温暖的、湿的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use warm, wet in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The water is warm. My coat is wet.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水是温的。 我的外套湿了。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: dry · boiling
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：干的、沸腾的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use dry, boiling in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The towel is dry. The boiling water is hot.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 毛巾是干的。 沸腾的水很烫。

groups.title: Colour, Light, and the Senses: soft · rough · smooth
groups.titleZh: 颜色、光线与感官：柔软的、粗糙的、光滑的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use soft, rough, smooth in the “Colour, Light, and the Senses” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The cushion is soft. The bark is rough. This stone is smooth.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 靠垫很柔软。 树皮很粗糙。 这块石头很光滑。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: bent · cut · deep
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：弯的、切开的、深的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use bent, cut, deep in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This wire is bent. The cut apple is on the plate. This river is deep.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这根金属丝弯了。 切开的苹果在盘子里。 这条河很深。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: elastic · fat · flat
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：有弹性的、肥胖的、平的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use elastic, fat, flat in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This band is elastic. The fat cat is on the mat. This table has a flat top.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这条带子有弹性。 胖猫在垫子上。 这张桌子的表面是平的。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: full · hanging
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：满的、悬挂着的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use full, hanging in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The cup is full. The hanging lamp is above the table.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 杯子满了。 悬挂的灯在桌子上方。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: hard · high
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：坚硬的、高的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use hard, high in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The stone is hard. The shelf is high.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 石头很硬。 架子很高。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: hollow · long
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：空心的、长的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use hollow, long in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This pipe is hollow. The snake is long.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这根管子是空心的。 这条蛇很长。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: low · narrow · open
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：低的、窄的、开着的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use low, narrow, open in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The table is low. The path is narrow. The door is open.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 桌子很低。 这条小路很窄。 门开着。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: parallel · right · round
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：平行的、正确的、圆的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use parallel, right, round in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The two lines are parallel. Your answer is right. The ball is round.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这两条线是平行的。 你的答案是对的。 球是圆的。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: sharp · short
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：锋利的、短的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use sharp, short in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The knife is sharp. This pencil is short.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 刀很锋利。 这支铅笔很短。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: straight · tall
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：直的、高个的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use straight, tall in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This line is straight. The tree is tall.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这条线是直的。 这棵树长得很高。

groups.title: Shape, Size, and Position: thick · thin · wide
groups.titleZh: 形状、大小与位置：厚的、薄的、宽的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use thick, thin, wide in the “Shape, Size, and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This book is thick. This paper is thin. This road is wide.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这本书很厚。 这张纸很薄。 这条路很宽。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: automatic · broken · chemical
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：自动的、破损的、化学的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use automatic, broken, chemical in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The store has an automatic door. The cup is broken. Rust forms through a chemical change.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 商店有一扇自动门。 杯子破了。 铁锈通过化学变化形成。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: electric · fixed · free
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：电动的、固定的、自由的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use electric, fixed, free in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We have an electric car. The shelf is fixed to the wall. The bird is free to go.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们有一辆电动汽车。 架子固定在墙上。 小鸟可以自由离开。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: frequent · living
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：频繁的、活着的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use frequent, living in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We make frequent trips to the library. A tree is a living thing.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们常常去图书馆。 树是活着的生物。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: material · natural
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：物质的、天然的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use material, natural in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Food and water are material needs. Wood is a natural material.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 食物和水是物质需求。 木材是天然材料。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: new · normal
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：新的、正常的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use new, normal in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is my new bag. It is normal to feel tired after a run.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是我的新袋子。 跑步后感到累是正常的。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: quick · quiet · ready
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：快的、安静的、准备好的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use quick, quiet, ready in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The rabbit is quick. The room is quiet. I am ready for school.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 兔子跑得快。 房间里很安静。 我准备好去上学了。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: regular · slow · solid
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：有规律的、慢的、固体的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use regular, slow, solid in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We take regular breaks. The snail is slow. Ice is solid water.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们定时休息。 蜗牛行动很慢。 冰是固态的水。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: sticky · stiff
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：黏的、硬挺的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use sticky, stiff in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The glue is sticky. This brush has stiff bristles.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 胶水是黏的。 这把刷子的刷毛很硬挺。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: sudden · tight
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：突然的、紧的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use sudden, tight in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A sudden noise wakes the cat. My shoes are tight.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 突然的响声惊醒了猫。 我的鞋很紧。

groups.title: States, Speed, and Readiness: waiting · awake · shut
groups.titleZh: 状态、速度与准备：等候中的、醒着的、关着的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use waiting, awake, shut in the “States, Speed, and Readiness” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The waiting children have books. The baby is awake. The window is shut.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 等候中的孩子们拿着书。 婴儿醒着。 窗户关着。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: able · angry · chief
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：有能力的、生气的、主要的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use able, angry, chief in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I am able to read this book. He is angry about the broken toy. Our chief aim is to help.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我能够读这本书。 玩具坏了，他很生气。 我们的主要目的是提供帮助。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: conscious · dependent · happy
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：清醒的、依赖的、开心的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use conscious, dependent, happy in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The patient is conscious now. The baby is dependent on her parents. I am happy today.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 病人现在清醒了。 婴儿依赖她的父母。 我今天很开心。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: healthy · important
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：健康的、重要的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use healthy, important in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The baby is healthy. Clean water is important.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 婴儿很健康。 干净的水很重要。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: kind · like
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：友善的、相似的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use kind, like in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: My friend is kind. The two friends have like interests.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的朋友很友善。 这两个朋友有相似的兴趣。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: male · married
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：雄性的、已婚的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use male, married in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The male lion has a mane. My aunt is married.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 雄狮有鬃毛。 我的阿姨结婚了。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: medical · military · poor
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：医疗的、军事的、贫穷的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use medical, military, poor in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The hospital gives medical care. The museum has military uniforms. The story is about a poor family.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 医院提供医疗护理。 博物馆里有军装。 故事讲的是一个贫穷的家庭。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: responsible · serious · strong
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：负有责任的、认真的、强壮的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use responsible, serious, strong in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I am responsible for feeding the cat. We have a serious talk. The horse is strong.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我负责给猫喂食。 我们进行了一次认真的谈话。 这匹马很强壮。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: tired · violent
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：累的、猛烈的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use tired, violent in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I am tired after the walk. A violent storm shakes the trees.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 走路后我累了。 猛烈的暴风雨摇撼着树木。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: wise · young
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：明智的、年幼的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use wise, young in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Taking water is a wise choice. The young bird is small.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 带水是明智的选择。 幼鸟很小。

groups.title: People, Feelings, and Character: female · foolish · sad
groups.titleZh: 人物、感受与性格：雌性的、愚蠢的、伤心的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use female, foolish, sad in the “People, Feelings, and Character” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The female lion has no mane. It is foolish to go out without a coat. I am sad about my lost toy.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 雌狮没有鬃毛。 不穿外套就出门是不明智的。 玩具丢了，我很伤心。

groups.title: Measure and Position: addition · bit · degree
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：加法、小块、度（温度单位）
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use addition, bit, degree in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We do addition with small numbers. There is a bit of cake left. The temperature goes up one degree.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们用小数字做加法。 还剩一小块蛋糕。 温度升高了一度。

groups.title: Measure and Position: direction · distance · division
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：方向、距离、除法
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use direction, distance, division in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Which direction is the school? The distance to school is short. We learn division with twelve blocks.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 学校在哪个方向？ 到学校的距离很短。 我们用十二块积木学除法。

groups.title: Measure and Position: level · limit
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：水平高度、限度
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use level, limit in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The water level is high. There is a limit of five books.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水位很高。 最多可以拿五本书。

groups.title: Measure and Position: measure · middle
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：计量单位、中间
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use measure, middle in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A metre is a measure of length. The ball is in the middle of the room.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 米是一种长度计量单位。 球在房间的中间。

groups.title: Measure and Position: part · place
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：部分、地方
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use part, place in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This part of the story is funny. This is a quiet place.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 故事的这一部分很有趣。 这是一个安静的地方。

groups.title: Measure and Position: point · position · range
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：尖端、位置、范围
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use point, position, range in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The pencil has a sharp point. The map shows our position. The store has a wide range of books.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 铅笔有一个尖尖的笔尖。 地图显示我们的位置。 商店里有种类丰富的书。

groups.title: Measure and Position: scale · side · size
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：刻度、侧面、大小
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use scale, side, size in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The scale on this ruler shows centimetres. The door is at the side of the house. What size is your shoe?
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这把尺子的刻度标出厘米。 门在房子的侧面。 你穿多大的鞋？

groups.title: Measure and Position: top · unit
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：顶部、单位
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use top, unit in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The bird is at the top of the tree. A metre is a unit of length.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 鸟在树的顶部。 米是长度单位。

groups.title: Measure and Position: way · group
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：路、一组
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use way, group in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is the way to school. A group of children is in the garden.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是去学校的路。 一群孩子在花园里。

groups.title: Measure and Position: front · comparison · selection
groups.titleZh: 测量与位置：前面、比较、挑选的一组
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use front, comparison, selection in the “Measure and Position” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The garden is at the front of the house. We make a comparison of the two maps. We have a selection of fruit.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 花园在房子的前面。 我们比较这两张地图。 我们有挑选出来的几种水果。

groups.title: Materials and Making: brass · cloth · coal
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：黄铜、布、煤
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use brass, cloth, coal in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This bell is made of brass. This cloth is soft. Coal is black.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个铃是黄铜制成的。 这块布很柔软。 煤是黑色的。

groups.title: Materials and Making: copper · cork · cotton
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：铜、软木塞、棉花
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use copper, cork, cotton in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This wire is made of copper. The bottle has a cork. Cotton is soft and white.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这根金属丝是铜制的。 瓶子上有一个软木塞。 棉花又软又白。

groups.title: Materials and Making: gold · industry
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：黄金、工业
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use gold, industry in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This ring is made of gold. The town has a toy industry.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这枚戒指是金子做的。 这个城镇有玩具制造业。

groups.title: Materials and Making: invention · iron
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：发明、铁
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use invention, iron in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The telephone is a useful invention. This gate is made of iron.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 电话是一项有用的发明。 这扇大门是铁制的。

groups.title: Materials and Making: leather · linen
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：皮革、亚麻布
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use leather, linen in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: These shoes are made of leather. The tablecloth is made of linen.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这些鞋子是皮革做的。 桌布是亚麻布做的。

groups.title: Materials and Making: machine · metal · produce
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：机器、金属、农产品
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use machine, metal, produce in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This machine makes paper. Iron is a metal. The market sells fresh produce.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这台机器制造纸张。 铁是一种金属。 市场出售新鲜农产品。

groups.title: Materials and Making: process · silk · silver
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：过程、丝绸、银
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use process, silk, silver in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Making bread is a slow process. The scarf is made of silk. The ring is made of silver.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 做面包是一个缓慢的过程。 围巾是丝绸做的。 戒指是银制的。

groups.title: Materials and Making: steam · steel
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：蒸汽、钢
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use steam, steel in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Steam comes from the hot water. The bridge is made of steel.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 热水冒出蒸汽。 桥是钢制的。

groups.title: Materials and Making: structure · substance
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：结构、物质
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use structure, substance in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The bridge has a strong structure. Ice is a cold substance.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这座桥的结构很牢固。 冰是一种冷的物质。

groups.title: Materials and Making: tin · wood · wool
groups.titleZh: 材料与制造：锡、木头、羊毛
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use tin, wood, wool in the “Materials and Making” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Tin is a soft metal. The table is made of wood. This hat is made of wool.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 锡是一种较软的金属。 桌子是木头做的。 这顶帽子是羊毛做的。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: adjustment · apparatus · balance
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：调整、器材、平衡
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use adjustment, apparatus, balance in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The seat needs a small adjustment. The science room has new apparatus. I keep my balance on one foot.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 座位需要稍微调一下。 科学教室里有新器材。 我单脚站立保持平衡。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: base · building · burst
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：底座、建筑物、爆裂
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use base, building, burst in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The lamp has a round base. This building has many windows. The burst of the balloon makes a noise.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 灯有一个圆底座。 这座建筑物有很多窗户。 气球爆裂时发出响声。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: control · crack
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：控制、裂缝
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use control, crack in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The driver has control of the bus. There is a crack in the cup.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 司机控制着公交车。 杯子上有一道裂缝。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: crush · current
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：拥挤的人群、水流
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use crush, current in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: There is a crush of people at the gate. The current carries the leaf downstream.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 大门口人群拥挤。 水流把叶子带向下游。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: curve · damage
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：曲线、损坏
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use curve, damage in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The path makes a curve round the tree. The storm causes damage to the roof.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 小路弯曲着绕过那棵树。 暴风雨损坏了屋顶。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: destruction · edge · effect
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：毁坏、边缘、效果
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use destruction, edge, effect in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The storm causes the destruction of the bridge. Keep the cup away from the edge. Sunlight has an effect on plant growth.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 暴风雨毁坏了那座桥。 把杯子放得离边缘远一点。 阳光对植物生长有影响。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: expansion · force · grip
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：膨胀、力、紧握
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use expansion, force, grip in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Heat causes the expansion of air. The wind pushes the sail with great force. Keep a firm grip on the rail.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 热使空气膨胀。 风用很大的力推动船帆。 紧紧抓住栏杆。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: hole · instrument
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：洞、乐器
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use hole, instrument in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: There is a hole in my sock. The violin is a musical instrument.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的袜子上有一个洞。 小提琴是一种乐器。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: mass · operation
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：大量（聚在一起）、运行
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use mass, operation in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A mass of clouds fills the sky. The machine is in operation.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 大片云朵布满天空。 机器正在运行。

groups.title: Forces and Machines: power · weight · blow
groups.titleZh: 力与机器：电力、重量、一击
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use power, weight, blow in the “Forces and Machines” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The wind gives us power. We check the weight of the box. One blow of the hammer moves the nail.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 风给我们电力。 我们称一下盒子的重量。 锤子敲一下，钉子就往里进了一点。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: account · act · chance
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：叙述、行为、机会
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use account, act, chance in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: She gives an account of her trip. Helping a friend is a kind act. Everyone has a chance to speak.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 她讲述了自己的旅行。 帮助朋友是一种友善的行为。 每个人都有机会发言。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: change · day · death
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：变化、一天、死亡
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use change, day, death in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We see a change in the weather. We have a whole day to play. The death of the old tree makes us sad.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们看到天气有了变化。 我们有一整天可以玩。 老树死了，我们很伤心。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: development · discovery
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：发展、发现
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use development, discovery in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Water helps the development of the plant. The discovery of a nest makes us happy.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水帮助植物生长发育。 发现鸟巢让我们很开心。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: end · event
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：末端、事件
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use end, event in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The shop is at the end of the road. The school fair is a happy event.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 商店在这条路的尽头。 学校游园会是一件快乐的事。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: existence · experience
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：存在、经历
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use existence, experience in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Water is necessary for our existence. The trip is a new experience.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水是我们生存的必要条件。 这次旅行是一次新的经历。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: growth · history · hour
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：生长、历史、小时
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use growth, history, hour in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Water helps the growth of plants. We learn the history of our town. An hour has sixty minutes.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水帮助植物生长。 我们学习自己城镇的历史。 一小时有六十分钟。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: increase · minute · month
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：增加、分钟、月
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use increase, minute, month in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: There is an increase in the number of birds. Wait here for one minute. This month has thirty days.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 鸟的数量增加了。 在这里等一分钟。 这个月有三十天。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: morning · night
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：早晨、夜晚
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use morning, night in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The sun comes up in the morning. We see stars at night.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 太阳在早晨升起。 我们在夜晚看见星星。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: reaction · tendency
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：反应、倾向
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use reaction, tendency in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Her reaction to the gift is a smile. The cat has a tendency to hide.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 她收到礼物后微笑了。 这只猫经常喜欢躲起来。

groups.title: Time, Events, and Change: time · week · year
groups.titleZh: 时间、事件与变化：时间、星期、年
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use time, week, year in the “Time, Events, and Change” scene.
groups.sharedExample: It is time for school. A week has seven days. A year has twelve months.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 到上学的时间了。 一个星期有七天。 一年有十二个月。

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: agreement · approval · argument
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：约定、同意、争论
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use agreement, approval, argument in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
