groups.sharedExample: We have an agreement to share the toys. We need our teacher's approval. They have an argument about the rules.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们约定一起分享玩具。 我们需要老师的同意。 他们为了规则争论起来。

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: attention · belief · decision
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：注意力、信念、决定
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use attention, belief, decision in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Give the story your attention. His belief is that kindness matters. We make a decision together.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 专心听故事。 他相信善良很重要。 我们一起作决定。

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: discussion · doubt
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：讨论、怀疑
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use discussion, doubt in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We have a discussion about the story. I have no doubt that you can do it.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们讨论这个故事。 我毫不怀疑你能做到。

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: idea · meeting
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：想法、会议
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use idea, meeting in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I have an idea for a picture. The meeting is at school.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我有了画画的想法。 会议在学校举行。

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: mind · news
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：头脑、消息
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use mind, news in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A question comes into my mind. I have good news for you.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我的脑海里出现一个问题。 我有好消息告诉你。

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: observation · opinion · reason
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：观察、意见、理由
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use observation, opinion, reason in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Careful observation helps us learn. What is your opinion of the story? What is the reason for the change?
groups.sharedExampleZh: 仔细观察帮助我们学习。 你觉得这个故事怎么样？ 改变的理由是什么？

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: request · statement · suggestion
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：请求、陈述、建议
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use request, statement, suggestion in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
groups.sharedExample: She makes a request for help. Her statement is true. Your suggestion is a good one.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 她提出帮助请求。 她的陈述是真实的。 你的建议很好。

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: talk · theory
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：谈话、理论
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use talk, theory in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We have a talk about the trip. The theory explains how rain forms.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们谈论这次旅行。 这个理论解释雨怎样形成。

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: view · connection
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：景色、连接
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use view, connection in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The window gives us a view of the sea. Check the connection between the two parts.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 从窗户可以看到海景。 检查这两个零件之间的连接。

groups.title: Ideas and Decisions: desire · purpose · detail
groups.titleZh: 想法与决定：愿望、目的、细节
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use desire, purpose, detail in the “Ideas and Decisions” scene.
groups.sharedExample: She has a desire to learn. The purpose of the trip is to see birds. The picture has a lot of detail.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 她有学习的愿望。 这次旅行的目的是观鸟。 这幅画有很多细节。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: authority · committee · country
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：权力、委员会、国家
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use authority, committee, country in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The teacher has authority in the classroom. The committee plans the school fair. China is a large country.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 老师在课堂上有管理权。 委员会筹划学校的游园会。 中国是一个大国。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: crime · government · judge
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：犯罪行为、政府、裁判
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use crime, government, judge in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Taking another person's money is a crime. The government builds public schools. The judge checks the answer.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 偷拿别人的钱是犯罪行为。 政府修建公立学校。 裁判核对答案。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: law · nation
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：法律、国家
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use law, nation in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The law helps keep people safe. People from every nation can be friends.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 法律帮助保护人们的安全。 各国人民都可以成为朋友。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: peace · protest
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：和平、抗议
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use peace, protest in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Everyone wants peace. They make a protest about the noise.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 每个人都希望和平。 他们对噪声提出抗议。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: punishment · religion
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：惩罚、宗教
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use punishment, religion in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The story explains the punishment for theft. People have different views about religion.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 故事解释了偷窃会受到的惩罚。 人们对宗教有不同看法。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: representative · rule · society
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：代表、规则、社会
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use representative, rule, society in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Our class has a representative. Our rule is to take turns. People in a society help each other.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们班有一名代表。 我们的规则是轮流来。 社会中的人们互相帮助。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: war · attack · fight
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：战争、攻击、打架
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use war, attack, fight in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The story is about life after a war. The shell protects the snail from attack. The two cats have a fight.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 故事讲述战争之后的生活。 外壳保护蜗牛免受攻击。 两只猫打了一架。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: danger · order
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：危险、次序
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use danger, order in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The sign warns us of danger. Put the books in order.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 标志提醒我们这里有危险。 把书按顺序放好。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: organization · servant
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：组织、佣人
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use organization, servant in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This organization helps animals. The servant works in the old house.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这个组织帮助动物。 佣人在那座老房子里工作。

groups.title: Community, Rules, and Peace: secretary · porter · harmony
groups.titleZh: 社区、规则与和平：秘书、搬运工、和睦
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use secretary, porter, harmony in the “Community, Rules, and Peace” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The secretary writes a letter. The porter takes our bags. The family lives in harmony.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 秘书写了一封信。 搬运工拿起我们的行李。 这家人和睦地生活。

groups.title: Business and Trade: advertisement · amount · business
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：广告、数量、生意
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use advertisement, amount, business in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The advertisement shows a new toy. There is a small amount of milk. My aunt has a small business.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 广告上展示了一件新玩具。 有少量的牛奶。 我的阿姨经营一份小生意。

groups.title: Business and Trade: company · competition · credit
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：公司、比赛、赊账
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use company, competition, credit in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The company makes toys. The school has an art competition. The store lets people buy on credit.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这家公司生产玩具。 学校举办了一场绘画比赛。 这家商店允许人们赊账购买。

groups.title: Business and Trade: debt · distribution
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：欠款、分发
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use debt, distribution in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: He pays his debt to the store. We help with the distribution of books.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 他偿还了欠商店的钱。 我们帮忙分发书本。

groups.title: Business and Trade: exchange · insurance
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：交换、保险
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use exchange, insurance in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We make an exchange of books. Our family has car insurance.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们交换书本。 我们家买了汽车保险。

groups.title: Business and Trade: interest · manager
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：兴趣、经理
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use interest, manager in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: I have an interest in birds. The manager works at the store.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我对鸟感兴趣。 经理在商店工作。

groups.title: Business and Trade: market · money · offer
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：市场、钱、提议
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use market, money, offer in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The market has fresh fruit. I keep my money in this box. Your offer of help is kind.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 市场里有新鲜水果。 我把钱放在这个盒子里。 你提出帮助，真友善。

groups.title: Business and Trade: owner · payment · price
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：主人、付款、价格
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use owner, payment, price in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The dog's owner is kind. The payment is for the books. What is the price of this book?
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这只狗的主人很友善。 这笔付款是买书的钱。 这本书多少钱？

groups.title: Business and Trade: profit · property
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：利润、财物
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use profit, property in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The shop makes a small profit. Take care of other people's property.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 商店获得少量利润。 爱护他人的财物。

groups.title: Business and Trade: rate · tax
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：速率、税
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use rate, tax in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The plant grows at a slow rate. People pay tax for public services.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 植物生长得很慢。 人们缴税来支持公共服务。

groups.title: Business and Trade: trade · value · work
groups.titleZh: 商业与贸易：贸易、价值、工作
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use trade, value, work in the “Business and Trade” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Trade brings food from other countries. This old book has great value. Our work is almost complete.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 贸易把食物从其他国家带来。 这本旧书很有价值。 我们的工作快完成了。

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: animal · attraction · comfort
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：动物、吸引力、安慰
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use animal, attraction, comfort in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: A cat is an animal. The bright flowers are an attraction for bees. The warm hug gives me comfort.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 猫是一种动物。 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。 温暖的拥抱给我安慰。

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: disgust · error · expert
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：厌恶、错误、专家
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use disgust, error, expert in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The bad smell fills him with disgust. There is an error in this sum. The expert tells us about birds.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 难闻的气味让他厌恶。 这道算式里有一个错误。 专家给我们讲鸟的知识。

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: hate · hope
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：仇恨、希望
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use hate, hope in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Hate can hurt people. We have hope for the little bird.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 仇恨会伤害人。 我们对这只小鸟抱有希望。

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: insect · loss
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：昆虫、失去
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use insect, loss in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: An ant is an insect. The loss of my toy makes me sad.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 蚂蚁是一种昆虫。 玩具丢了让我伤心。

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: mine · poison
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：矿井、毒物
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use mine, poison in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The workers go into the mine. This bottle has a label for poison.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 工人们进入矿井。 这个瓶子上有毒物标签。

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: powder · quality · regret
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：粉末、品质、遗憾
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use powder, quality, regret in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The powder is white and fine. This cloth is of good quality. I feel regret about the broken cup.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这种粉末又白又细。 这块布的品质很好。 杯子碎了，我感到遗憾。

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: reward · room · seat
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：回报、房间、座位
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use reward, room, seat in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Helping others can be its own reward. My room has a window. This is your seat.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 帮助别人本身就能带来满足。 我的房间有一扇窗户。 这是你的座位。

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: shame · sign
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：羞愧、标志
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use shame, sign in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: He feels shame about telling a lie. This sign shows the way to the park.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 他因说谎感到羞愧。 这个标志指示去公园的路。

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: soap · sort
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：肥皂、种类
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use soap, sort in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Use soap to wash your hands. What sort of fruit is this?
groups.sharedExampleZh: 用肥皂洗手。 这是什么种类的水果？

groups.title: Challenges and Systems: space · system · thing
groups.titleZh: 挑战与系统：空间、系统、东西
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use space, system, thing in the “Challenges and Systems” scene.
groups.sharedExample: There is space for one more book. The school has a system for sharing books. What is that small thing?
groups.sharedExampleZh: 还有放一本书的空间。 学校有一套共享书本的制度。 那个小东西是什么？

groups.title: Logic, Time, and Certainty: common · complex · equal
groups.titleZh: 逻辑、时间与确定性：常见的、复杂的、相等的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use common, complex, equal in the “Logic, Time, and Certainty” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Rain is common here. This machine is complex. The two parts are equal.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这里经常下雨。 这台机器很复杂。 这两部分一样大。

groups.title: Logic, Time, and Certainty: first · general · great
groups.titleZh: 逻辑、时间与确定性：第一的、普遍的、很大的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use first, general, great in the “Logic, Time, and Certainty” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is my first day at school. There is general agreement on the plan. The elephant has great strength.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是我上学的第一天。 大家普遍同意这个计划。 大象有很大的力气。

groups.title: Logic, Time, and Certainty: necessary · past
groups.titleZh: 逻辑、时间与确定性：必要的、过去的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use necessary, past in the “Logic, Time, and Certainty” scene.
groups.sharedExample: Water is necessary for life. We talk about past events.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 水是生命必需的。 我们谈论过去的事情。

groups.title: Logic, Time, and Certainty: possible · present
groups.titleZh: 逻辑、时间与确定性：可能的、现在的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use possible, present in the “Logic, Time, and Certainty” scene.
groups.sharedExample: It is possible to go by train. Our present home is near the school.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 可以坐火车去。 我们现在的家靠近学校。

groups.title: Logic, Time, and Certainty: private · probable
groups.titleZh: 逻辑、时间与确定性：私人的、很可能的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use private, probable in the “Logic, Time, and Certainty” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is a private garden. Rain is probable this evening.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是一个私人花园。 今晚很可能下雨。

groups.title: Logic, Time, and Certainty: same · second · separate
groups.titleZh: 逻辑、时间与确定性：相同的、第二的、分开的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use same, second, separate in the “Logic, Time, and Certainty” scene.
groups.sharedExample: We have the same book. This is my second cup of water. The toys are in separate boxes.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 我们有同样的书。 这是我的第二杯水。 玩具放在不同的盒子里。

groups.title: Logic, Time, and Certainty: true · certain · complete
groups.titleZh: 逻辑、时间与确定性：真实的、确定的、完整的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use true, certain, complete in the “Logic, Time, and Certainty” scene.
groups.sharedExample: This is a true story. I am certain this is my bag. This is the complete set of cards.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这是一个真实的故事。 我确定这是我的袋子。 这是一整套卡片。

groups.title: Logic, Time, and Certainty: different · false
groups.titleZh: 逻辑、时间与确定性：不同的、不真实的
groups.sharedContext: Learn and use different, false in the “Logic, Time, and Certainty” scene.
groups.sharedExample: The two bags are different. That statement is false.
groups.sharedExampleZh: 这两个袋子不一样。 那个说法不真实。

groups.title: Logic, Time, and Certainty: future · last
